dedupe_keys.name: code and analysis scripts for the manuscript using satellite observations to validate and improve reservoir storage simulations in global hydrological models

description: Emmanuel Okiria and colleagues publish Python analysis scripts for comparing reservoir-storage simulations with field measurements and satellite-derived storage series. The April 2026 deposit provides SaGHM.zip free under CC BY 4.0. Named scripts compare observation time series, plot simulated-versus-observed storage, generate skill-score box plots and visualise sensitivity results with Kling-Gupta Efficiency matrices. A Conda environment file and README describe dependencies and execution order. The intended coverage is reservoir representation in global hydrological models; specific reservoir lists, analysis periods and exact dependency versions remain unknown from the landing page. These tools can evaluate simulation performance but do not themselves supply a complete hydrological simulator or establish unrestricted access to every cited input dataset. Some analyses require manually enabling or disabling code blocks. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this analysis bundle. The scripts and environment were not installed or run.
